title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry: Linking Guest Purchases to a Registry
content:
A guest purchase is linked to a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry when the guest selects the registry at the purchase, so that the purchase record carries the registry. The guest gift entry on the registry is dated on the purchase date, or on the later link date when the gift is linked afterwards.

**Later linking.** A gift of an item on the registry bought without selecting the registry can be linked later at the registrant's or the guest's request — a registry request of the gift link type naming the purchase record — within the linking period in calendar days after its purchase date (60 for every registry type), counting the day after the purchase date as day 1. The later link is made on the purchase record. The purchase has not already been linked to a registry, as the registry's entries show for that purchase record.

**Other gifts.** Gifts of items not on the registry are linked but never reduce a requested quantity, and gift cards are never linked.

### Counting the linking period (hypothetical dates)

| Purchase date | Request made | Day number | Within the period? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 2 May | day 1 | yes |
| 1 May | 30 June | day 60 | yes |
| 1 May | 1 July | day 61 | no |

### Points of judgement

- The count starts the day after the purchase date; the purchase date itself is not day 1.
- A purchase already linked to a registry is not linked a second time.
- A gift card bought by a guest is never linked, whatever the timing.
